Space Grotesk text, JetBrains Mono numbers, square-ish corners, lime on near-black, a chart grid behind */:root{--acid:#b8ff3c;--acid-hover:#a6f01f;--acid-quiet:rgba(184,255,60,.16);--acid-ink:#0b0f0d;--sans:"Space Grotesk",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;--mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;--r:6px;--r2:6px;--r-lg:10px;--r-card:12px}[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#070908;--surface:#0d1110;--inset:rgba(184,255,60,.05);--inset-2:rgba(255,255,255,.03);--ink:#e9eee8;--ink-80:rgba(233,238,232,.82);--ink-2:rgba(233,238,232,.6);--ink-3:rgba(233,238,232,.6);--ink-4:rgba(233,238,232,.38);--line:rgba(184,255,60,.13);--line-2:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--line-3:rgba(184,255,60,.28);--up:#3dff8a;--up-text:#3dff8a;--dn:#ff4d5e;--dn-text:#ff5d6c;--card3:rgba(255,255,255,.1);--shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(184,255,60,.1);--shadow-raised:0 0 0 1px rgba(184,255,60,.16),0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55);--shadow-sm:0 0 0 1px rgba(184,255,60,.1)}[data-theme=dark] body{background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(184,255,60,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(184,255,60,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:44px 44px;background-attachment:fixed}body{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em}h1,h2,h3,b,strong{letter-spacing:-.02em}b,td,th,input,.kvl b,.fig b,.figs b,.big,.chf b,.out b,.tbl td,kbd,.badge,.mono{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.tbl td,.kvl b,.fig b,.figs b,.chf b,.chf span,.out b,.big,#t-mcb,#t-pxb,.l2,.l1 span,.kvs b{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.btn.pri,.go{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:700}

LiquidFi runs on two chains: HyperEVM, and Elysium, the HYPE-gas chain that settles to HyperEVM. A token lives on the chain it launched on. Tokens launch directly into Uniswap v4 and are quoted against HYPE only.
LeverHook runs on Robinhood Chain. Tokens launch directly into Uniswap v4 and are quoted against ETH only.
Two steps on HyperEVM or Elysium.
